title: Short exact sequence of module sheaves with prescribed open-cover mates
statement: Let X be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], R its underlying ring sheaf, U and V opens whose union is X, and W their intersection. Let SU, SV and SW be additive left adjoints to the respective additive restriction functors on module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with adjunctions aU, aV and aW. For an R-module sheaf F, define iU from SW(RW F) to SU(RU F) to be the aW-transpose of cU(F) inverse followed by the restriction to W of the aU unit at RU F followed by cU(SU(RU F)), where cU is overFunctorMap for W contained in U. Define iV by the analogous formula for V. For any proof hz that the difference lift (iU,-iV) composed with the pair of the aU and aV counits is zero, the resulting short complex is short exact in the category of module sheaves. No complexes occur in this statement.

source.place: Tag 08BU, proof (degreewise sequence); Tag 00A7 (extension-by-zero adjunction and stalks)

proof.text: Use the extension-by-zero functors constructed from extensionByZeroPresheaf and module sheafification, with their exact adjunctions. Their canonical nested transitions are the displayed unit transposes.

At a point in both opens, the stalk-map comparison identifies the sequence with the difference diagonal and addition. At a point in exactly one open, the intersection stalk and the other summand vanish, and the remaining counit is an isomorphism. The covering hypothesis rules out a point in neither open. All these module sequences are short exact, including the empty and equal-open cases.

Reflect exactness by module_stalk_exact. To reflect monicity of the first map apply the same exactness-reflection criterion to the sequence with zero first map and this map second; to reflect epicity of the second use the sequence with this map first and zero second. Thus the sequence of sheaves is short exact.

Compare the canonical left adjoints to the given adjoints by leftAdjointUniq. Unit, counit and Hom-equivalence compatibility identify the transported maps with the formulas in the statement, giving an isomorphism of short complexes. Transport short exactness along it; the chosen proof hz is immaterial by proof irrelevance.

theorem open_cover_mate_module_shortExact (X : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.{u})
    (R : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) RingCat.{u})
    (hR : R = (sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj X.sheaf)
    (U V : Opens X) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤)
    [(overFunctor.{u} R U).Additive] [(overFunctor.{u} R V).Additive]
    [(overFunctor.{u} R (U ⊓ V)).Additive]
    (SU : SheafOfModules.{u} (R.over U) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} R)
    (SV : SheafOfModules.{u} (R.over V) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} R)
    (SW : SheafOfModules.{u} (R.over (U ⊓ V)) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} R)
    [SU.Additive] [SV.Additive] [SW.Additive]
    (aU : SU ⊣ overFunctor.{u} R U) (aV : SV ⊣ overFunctor.{u} R V)
    (aW : SW ⊣ overFunctor.{u} R (U ⊓ V))
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} R) :
    let cU := overFunctorMap.{u} R (homOfLE inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ⟶ U)
    let cV := overFunctorMap.{u} R (homOfLE inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ⟶ V)
    let iU := (aW.homEquiv _ _).symm
      (cU.inv.app F ≫
        (overMap.{u} R (homOfLE inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ⟶ U)).map
          (aU.unit.app ((overFunctor.{u} R U).obj F)) ≫
        cU.hom.app (SU.obj ((overFunctor.{u} R U).obj F)))
    let iV := (aW.homEquiv _ _).symm
      (cV.inv.app F ≫
        (overMap.{u} R (homOfLE inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ⟶ V)).map
          (aV.unit.app ((overFunctor.{u} R V).obj F)) ≫
        cV.hom.app (SV.obj ((overFunctor.{u} R V).obj F)))
    ∀ hz : biprod.lift iU (-iV) ≫
        biprod.desc (aU.counit.app F) (aV.counit.app F) = 0,
      (ShortComplex.mk (biprod.lift iU (-iV))
        (biprod.desc (aU.counit.app F) (aV.counit.app F)) hz).ShortExact
